panels.burned_in_description: Imaging-viewer overlay on both CT frames: scan date and time stamps, image/series counters, acquisition parameters and viewer trial-licence banner, plus a short unmasked numeric ID-like field in the right margin (other margin fields masked with asterisks); no name or birth date visible.
panels.notes: Viewed axial and coronal CT frames. Overlay prints date/time stamps and device text; an unmasked ID-like numeric field sits below masked fields, so classified conservatively as a possible direct identifier. No face or sensitive anatomy; chest CT only.

burned_in: Viewer overlay text reads "2/24/2025 12:27:00 PM - MidIASTINAL VOL", "Im: 174/444", "Se: 4", "X: 141 Y: 288 Val: 32" (partly obscured), "WL: 50 WW: 350 [D]", "T: 1.3mm L: -140.6mm", "200mA 120kV", "2/24/2025 12:27:01 PM" and masked "***" fields.

Bottom: coronal reconstruction ("2/24/2025 12:27:09 PM - MidIASTINAL VOL", "Im: 211/512", "Se: 4", R left, L right, S at top) showing both lungs and a rounded soft-tissue structure in the lower mid-chest above the diaphragm;
Orientation letters R (viewer-left) and L (viewer-right) are printed on both images, so patient right is displayed on the viewer-left.
Burned-in overlay stamps read "2/24/2025 12:27:00 PM", "2/24/2025 12:27:01 PM" (axial) and "2/24/2025 12:27:09 PM" (coronal);
Burned-in date stamps read 2/24/2025 whereas the article text dates the studies 24/02/2024;

panels.notes: Viewed axial and coronal upper-abdominal/lower-chest CT slices. Only R/L orientation letters, no overlay text, dates or IDs. No face or sensitive anatomy.
